scope: Shared instructional objectives. Plans, not completed episodes.

paths.function: compare advantages and disadvantages of two or three options and recommend one
paths.cefr: explain a viewpoint giving the advantages and disadvantages of various options
episodeFunctions: car versus transit for a commute (colleague)
paths.assessmentTransfer: checkpoint recall of the comparison frame; segment review of connector terms; later Speak-tutor probe (free production, outside this spec): compare two options and recommend one

paths.function: give a detailed explanation of causes, consequences or a process and sustain it under requests for precision
paths.assessmentTransfer: recall of a causal carrier; probe: explain a process step by step with reasons

paths.function: state an opinion with two reasons, concede a point and rebut an objection
paths.cefr: account for and sustain opinions by providing relevant explanations, arguments and comments
paths.assessmentTransfer: recall of the concession frame; probe: defend an opinion against one objection

paths.function: speculate about consequences and hypothetical or counterfactual situations and assess risk
paths.cefr: speculate about causes, consequences, hypothetical situations
episodeFunctions: had you taken the other job (friend)
paths.assessmentTransfer: recall of the conditional carrier; probe: speculate about the consequences of a change

paths.function: outline a case for compensation or correction and negotiate a solution to a dispute
paths.cefr: cope linguistically to negotiate a solution to a dispute; outline a case for compensation using persuasive language
paths.assessmentTransfer: recall of the request carrier; probe: make a claim and respond to a partial offer

paths.function: handle a formal exchange, then relay or adapt it informally; adjust register and report speech
paths.cefr: express themselves clearly and politely in a formal or informal register appropriate to the situation and person; relay specific information
paths.assessmentTransfer: recall of the reporting carrier; probe: tell a friend what an official said

paths.function: co-plan under constraints, invite input, counter-propose, summarize what was agreed
paths.cefr: help along the progress of the work by inviting others to join in and say what they think; goal-oriented cooperation
paths.assessmentTransfer: recall of the proposal carrier; probe: plan something together and sum up the decision

paths.function: define, paraphrase and specify precisely; repair a misunderstanding
paths.cefr: clarify by paraphrase; give clear detailed descriptions
episodeFunctions: explain a term from your field (expert)
correct a misreport of your view (colleague)
paths.assessmentTransfer: recall of the definition frame; probe: explain a term and handle one follow-up

paths.function: sustain disagreement politely: hold the floor, concede partially, close without losing the point; no new carriers
paths.cefr: present and respond to complex lines of argument convincingly; intervene appropriately in discussion
episodeFunctions: push back on a landlord claim (landlord)
paths.assessmentTransfer: recall of a floor-management frame; probe: disagree with someone who interrupts

paths.function: develop a personal position across three turns, absorb a challenge, end with a nuanced conclusion; consolidation, no new carriers
paths.cefr: develop an argument systematically with appropriate highlighting of significant points and relevant supporting detail
episodeFunctions: your plan one year from now
paths.assessmentTransfer: recall of a structuring connector; probe: a two-minute stance that survives one challenge

draftingOrder.stage0: no content: write 12 path spec files and 12 trophy ledgers (ledger check script against the active corpus), the offline validator, and two handwritten exemplar episodes per script family (Latin/German, Japanese, Korean, Cebuano/Indonesian, Slavic) used only as schema fixtures; needs Node and the registry, no runtime, server, UI or paid API
draftingOrder.stage1: German B2 P1–P2 (B1 live, owner verifies natively) → review → freeze → the exemplars and P1 feed the later device calibration of speak profiles
draftingOrder.stage2: languages with staged B1 P1: finish B1 P2–P10 first; B2 P1–P5 may start once B1 P1–P5 are reviewed (recycling targets exist), B2 P6–P10 after B1 P10
draftingOrder.stage3: languages without B1: B1 P1–P10 under the B1 contract with rails in this format, then B2
draftingOrder.priorityRationale: validator maturity on space-joined scripts first, market weight second, segmentation complexity (eojeol, bunsetsu, clitics) and reviewer availability last; owner may reorder
draftingOrder.batchDiscipline: Codex runs cap at 2–3 paths; no helper factoring in content files; validator plus full read before accepting; adversarial review per batch; activation per language only after that language's B1 is active and the 12 base editions exist
draftingOrder.activationGate: a path is activatable only when frozen, reviewed, compiled byte-identically twice, and listed in the trophy-fallback matrix test
